name: What is the process for getting an estimate for woodwork restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting an estimate for woodwork restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get an estimate for original woodwork restoration, the process begins with contacting us to schedule an on-site consultation. During this visit, our specialists will thoroughly inspect the woodwork, discuss your vision and concerns, and take necessary measurements. We then use this information to prepare a detailed, itemized proposal outlining the scope of work, recommended materials, and associated costs. This ensures you have a clear understanding of the project before any work begins.
